'''Matthew''' (Japanese: '''マシュー''' ''Matthew'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP059|Luxray Vision!]]''.

Matthew is the owner of a strange manor with hidden traps and tunnels. He had hired {{OBP|Marble|DP059}} to help protect the [[Old Charm]] from [[Team Rocket trio|The Bandit Beauties Three]] after receiving a threatening letter from them. Eventually, he also enlisted the help of {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} after they stumbled upon his mansion.
